articles.summary: The ManpowerGroup Employment Outlook Survey for Q4 2026. More than 39,000 employers across 42 countries reported a seasonally adjusted Net Employment Outlook (NEO) of 29% as they forecasted Q4 staffing changes in the latest edition of the ManpowerGroup Employment Outlook Survey.
articles.title: Q4 2026 ManpowerGroup Employment Outlook Survey
